import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f11 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0011.png').convert('RGB'))

# Cabinet mask: light grey
cab_mask = (f11[:, :, 0] > 100) & (f11[:, :, 0] < 240) & (f11[:, :, 0] == f11[:, :, 1]) & (f11[:, :, 1] == f11[:, :, 2])
# In F11, cabinet is on right side
y_c, x_c = np.where(cab_mask)
print('Cabinet in F11: x in', x_c.min(), x_c.max(), 'y in', y_c.min(), y_c.max())

# Bottom corners/edges:
# Left bottom edge of cabinet:
left_pixels = cab_mask[:, x_c.min():x_c.min()+10]
y_l, x_l = np.where(left_pixels)
print('Left bottom y:', y_l.max())

# Right bottom edge:
right_pixels = cab_mask[:, x_c.max()-10:x_c.max()+1]
y_r, x_r = np.where(right_pixels)
print('Right bottom y:', y_r.max())
"
